userStories.title: Constrain slug-less comment mutations and project listing by membership
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Scope slug-less comment edits and the project list to membership and verify the complete guarded route matrix over HTTP.

**Motivation** — The 2026-09-25 review found membership enforced on links, VCS, memory, context and code-intel but not on tickets, comments, labels or the project list (M7).

**Approach** — `CommentsService.update(commentId, dto, principal)` / `delete(commentId, principal)`: resolve comment → ticket → project first; a user who is not a member of that project gets `NotFoundAppException` (404) before any CASL check. Agent principals skip membership resolution and proceed to CASL; global ADMIN may delete without membership. Extend PrismaCommentRepository with the owning-ticket/project resolution and use ProjectAccessService's membership check, translating a non-member's ForbiddenAppException to NotFoundAppException; missing/deleted project must not become visible. `ProjectsService.findAll()` → `findAllForPrincipal(principal: KodaPrincipal): Promise<ProjectDomain[]>`: agents and global ADMIN users get every non-deleted project; other users get only projects where they have a `ProjectMember` row. Keep the existing ProjectResponseDto mapping at the HTTP boundary. Pass @Principal() from ProjectsController.findAll, filter via PrismaProjectRepository, and set CommentsController.deleteFromHttp to return HTTP 204 for the specified global ADMIN deletion. Add `apps/api/test/integration/projects/project-membership-gate.integration.spec.ts` following the PG-backed supertest `KODA_DB_TESTS=1` pattern: real HTTP requests for every specified route as member and non-member, plus comment-by-ID and project list. Test member statuses as specified, without redefining global CASL or existing agent-admin permissions.

**Interface** — `ProjectsService.findAll()` → `findAllForPrincipal(principal: KodaPrincipal): Promise<ProjectDomain[]>`; `CommentsService.update(commentId, dto, principal)` / `delete(commentId, principal)`.

**Scope** — In: slug-less comment ownership lookup and status, project list, complete HTTP route-matrix integration and affected unit specs. Out: guard creation and slug-route wiring (US-001), agent create/pickup (US-003); Project-role-based permissions: write permissions stay on the principal's global role and `ProjectMember.role` gates visibility only (Track 3 ruling 2026-09-27), with one exception ruled 2026-09-27: KB write routes refuse a project VIEWER via `@ProjectRoles`. Tickets, comments and labels do not use `@ProjectRoles`.

userStories.title: Harden agent creation and restrict agent ticket pickup
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Whitelist and atomically persist agent creation, map duplicate slugs to 409, and restrict pickup to self/global ADMIN.

**Motivation** — Agent creation spreads the request body into Prisma (M8) and a duplicate slug returns 500.

**Approach** — `AgentsService` create path (`agents/agents.service.ts`, the `else` branch that spreads `...scalarFields`): builds the create data from `name`, `slug`, `maxConcurrentTickets` only; writes the agent row, roles and capabilities inside one `txManager.run`. The constructor gains `@Inject(TRANSACTION_MANAGER) private readonly txManager: ITransactionManager` (the pattern used by `comments.service.ts`). Hash the generated key as before; call agentRepo.create with exactly name, slug, apiKeyHash and maxConcurrentTickets. Validate slug format in both the active HTTP-bound service-local CreateAgentDto and `agents/dto/create-agent.dto.ts` (which becomes canonical in US-005); reject 'Bad Slug!', allow 'good-slug-1'. Preserve optional roles/capabilities across the canonical DTO transition. Map duplicate agent slug to ConflictAppException (409). `PrismaAgentRepository.createRolesAndCapabilities`: sequential `createMany` calls on the ambient transaction client (no nested `$transaction([...])`); role/capability failure rolls back the new agent row. `AgentsController.suggestTicket` (`GET agents/:slug/pickup`) gains a `@Principal() principal: KodaPrincipal` parameter and passes it through, including its pickupTicket helper. `AgentsService.suggestTicket(agentSlug, projectSlug)` → `suggestTicket(agentSlug, projectSlug, principal)`: 403 unless the principal is that agent or a global ADMIN user; 404 when the project is missing or soft-deleted. Preserve ranking/response for authorized agents.

**Interface** — `@Inject(TRANSACTION_MANAGER) private readonly txManager: ITransactionManager`; `AgentsService.suggestTicket(agentSlug, projectSlug, principal)`; `@Principal() principal: KodaPrincipal`.

**Scope** — In: create whitelist and transaction, HTTP slug validation, duplicate conflict, pickup permission and affected specs. Out: service-local DTO deletion/import cleanup (US-005). US-003 only: the agent `update()` path, which already whitelists its fields. Agent project membership: agent principals remain cross-project and bypass the membership gate (revisited in fleet S1).

userStories.title: Fix project conflict responses, auth secrets and domain-writer role provenance
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Resolve project/auth LOWs by normalizing project errors, adding translations, enforcing independent JWT secrets and deriving event roles from membership.

**Motivation** — Six LOWs in the same modules remain open.

**Approach** — `ProjectsService.create` / `update`: duplicate slug or key → `ConflictAppException` (409); `update` on a soft-deleted project → `NotFoundAppException`; preserve invalid-format validation. Add `projects.slugInvalid`, `projects.keyInvalid` and `common.validation.isIn` translations in both `en` and `zh` (projects.json and common.json). `envSchema` (`config/env.validation.ts`): validation fails when `JWT_REFRESH_SECRET` equals `JWT_SECRET`; throw a validation error naming JWT_REFRESH_SECRET rather than losing field detail in validate(). `KodaDomainWriter.writeTicketEvent`: for user actors, `projectRoles` is the actor's `ProjectMember.role` for `data.projectId` (plus 'ADMIN' when the user's global role is ADMIN); payload role fields are ignored. The data comes from a new `PrismaKodaDomainWriterRepository.findUserProjectRoles(projectId, userId): Promise<string[]>` (reads `User.role` and `ProjectMember.role`); `WriteTicketEventInput` is unchanged. Preserve agent actor role loading through AgentAuthProvider, event/outbox result, and project not-found checks. Adapt project and domain-writer specs to DB-derived roles.

**Interface** — `PrismaKodaDomainWriterRepository.findUserProjectRoles(projectId, userId): Promise<string[]>`; `WriteTicketEventInput` is unchanged.

**Scope** — In: project conflict/soft-delete responses, en/zh i18n keys, JWT env refinement, authenticated ticket-event role derivation. Out: slug guard and project list (US-001/US-002), agent create conflict (US-003); The webhook, ticket-workflow, VCS, RAG and web/CLI findings of Track 3 slices 2-6.

userStories.title: Remove redundant RAG membership checks and service-local agent DTOs
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Remove duplicate membership and DTO implementations after the shared guard and hardened agent-create path are available.

**Motivation** — Membership checks are duplicated and agent creation has duplicate DTO code that can diverge from HTTP validation.

**Approach** — Deletion-only: delete `RagController.checkProjectMembership`, `RetrievalController.checkProjectMembership` (both private copies of the membership rule, replaced by `ProjectMembershipGuard` on those controllers), the now-unused `PrismaRagRepository.findProjectMembership`, and delete the service-local `CreateAgentDto` / `UpdateAgentDto` classes in `agents/agents.service.ts` so every caller imports `agents/dto/*`. Apply `ProjectMembershipGuard` at class level to RetrievalController (`projects/:slug/kb/evaluate/retrieval`), where RetrievalModule already imports ProjectAccessModule. Preserve RetrievalController's resolveProject project-existence check; remove both private check call sites and associated obsolete specs; change controller/service/spec DTO imports to canonical DTOs. Guard in RagController and hardened agent create remain from upstream stories.

**Interface** — `@UseGuards(ProjectMembershipGuard)` on `RetrievalController`; `CreateAgentDto` / `UpdateAgentDto` imported from `agents/dto/*`.

**Scope** — In: duplicate-check and local DTO removal, RetrievalController guard and canonical DTO caller imports, updating RagController and RetrievalController specs. Out: guard creation and KB role rules (US-001), agent create transaction and pickup restriction (US-003); Agent project membership: agent principals remain cross-project and bypass the membership gate (revisited in fleet S1).
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/projects/:slug/kb/documents by a non-member DEVELOPER still returns 403 after RagController.checkProjectMembership is deleted.
POST /api/projects/:slug/kb/evaluate/retrieval by a non-member DEVELOPER returns 403 with ProjectMembershipGuard applied to RetrievalController.
POST /api/agents with a valid body still returns 201 after the service-local DTO classes are deleted.

routing.reasoning: Mostly removal of duplicated code and import substitution, but moving retrieval to a guard changes access control and therefore requires isolated security tests.

modifiedFiles.reason: tests of the private `checkProjectMembership` are deleted; guard behaviour is covered by US-001.
tests of the private `checkProjectMembership` are deleted; the invariant becomes that a non-member user gets 403 from `ProjectMembershipGuard`.

analysis: Existing NestJS/Prisma API in apps/api; no new package or schema migration. ProjectAccessService resolves slugs and rejects soft-deleted projects, skips membership checks for agents and global ADMIN, and delegates membership lookup to PrismaProjectRepository.findMembershipRole (apps/api/src/projects/project-access.service.ts:10-28; apps/api/src/projects/prisma-project.repository.ts:62-69). ProjectAccessModule exports this service and should provide/export the new guard (apps/api/src/projects/project-access.module.ts:5-19). UserPrincipal.role is MEMBER|ADMIN; DEVELOPER and VIEWER are ProjectMember roles, not valid global user roles: HTTP fixtures describing a 'DEVELOPER user' should use a MEMBER principal and DEVELOPER project role (apps/api/src/auth/principal/koda-principal.types.ts:4-30). TicketsController is entirely under projects/:slug/tickets; only assign currently checks membership inline (apps/api/src/tickets/tickets.controller.ts:45-52,235-249). LabelsController and CommentsController use method-level project routes and CommentsController also has slug-less comments/:id routes, so do not apply a controller-level guard there (apps/api/src/labels/labels.controller.ts:75-122; apps/api/src/comments/comments.controller.ts:69-121). RagController and RetrievalController each have duplicated membership checks; RagController's KB write endpoints also need project VIEWER exclusion without changing read/search or global permissions (apps/api/src/rag/rag.controller.ts:23-76,80-211; apps/api/src/retrieval/retrieval.controller.ts:10-55). ProjectsController's GET :slug and PATCH :slug/agents/:agentSlug need method-level guard; ADMIN-only routes and already gated impact/agent-list routes remain unchanged (apps/api/src/projects/projects.controller.ts:59-105,112-211). CommentsModule, LabelsModule and RagModule need ProjectAccessModule for guard injection; TicketsModule imports ProjectsModule, which exports ProjectAccessModule; RetrievalModule imports ProjectAccessModule already (apps/api/src/comments/comments.module.ts:9-13; apps/api/src/labels/labels.module.ts:7-10; apps/api/src/rag/rag.module.ts:126-130; apps/api/src/tickets/tickets.module.ts:17-20; apps/api/src/projects/projects.module.ts:14-33; apps/api/src/retrieval/retrieval.module.ts:7-10). Existing project list is unscoped but PrismaProjectRepository.findAll filters deletedAt: add membership-filtered query, preserve response DTO mapping while passing @Principal() from controller (apps/api/src/projects/projects.service.ts:68-70; apps/api/src/projects/prisma-project.repository.ts:39-44; apps/api/src/projects/projects.controller.ts:64-67). Comment records have ticketId only; resolving comment -> ticket -> project requires repository support before the service CASL check. Agents and global ADMIN bypass membership, while user non-members get 404; DELETE comments/:id currently declares @HttpCode(200) and returns JsonResponse.Ok(null), but spec requires 204, so change the HTTP response (apps/api/src/comments/comments.service.ts:122-167; apps/api/src/comments/prisma-comment.repository.ts:17-31; apps/api/src/comments/comments.controller.ts:105-121). HTTP integration pattern uses PG/supertest and KODA_DB_TESTS=1, resetDb/bootHttpApp/loginToken (apps/api/test/integration/live/live-stream.integration.spec.ts:1-19,49-95). Existing agent service has service-local CreateAgentDto/UpdateAgentDto definitions, though canonical agents/dto/* files exist; controller imports local CreateAgentDto, and agent service specs import it, so eventual deletion needs caller/test changes (apps/api/src/agents/agents.service.ts:14-71; apps/api/src/agents/agents.controller.ts:2-4; apps/api/src/agents/agents.service.spec.ts:2; apps/api/src/agents/dto/create-agent.dto.ts:1-14). The canonical CreateAgentDto currently has only required name/slug; preserve optional roles/capabilities behavior when switching types in US-005. Agent create spreads scalarFields into agentRepo.create, then writes roles/capabilities separately, whose repository method nests $transaction; inject ITransactionManager into AgentsService and use ambient Prisma client with sequential creates (apps/api/src/agents/agents.service.ts:81-92,119-180; apps/api/src/agents/prisma-agent.repository.ts:42-51,79-94). Existing AgentsService unit provider stubs lack TRANSACTION_MANAGER and its pickup unit tests call the old two-argument signature; update them (apps/api/src/agents/agents.service.spec.ts:55-114,695-767). Pickup controller omits principal; service currently returns null for a missing project and repository lookup includes soft-deleted rows; restrict to agent-self/global ADMIN, return 404 for absent/deleted project (apps/api/src/agents/agents.controller.ts:37-44,106-115; apps/api/src/agents/agents.service.ts:259-269; apps/api/src/agents/prisma-agent.repository.ts:115-117). ProjectsService duplicate checks currently raise ValidationAppException and update accepts deleted projects; change conflicts to 409, update-deleted to 404 while retaining invalid-format validation (apps/api/src/projects/projects.service.ts:21-65,82-132). Both locales require missing projects.slugInvalid/keyInvalid in projects.json and common.validation.isIn in common.json (apps/api/src/i18n/en/projects.json:1-7; apps/api/src/i18n/zh/projects.json:1-7; apps/api/src/i18n/en/common.json:2-14; apps/api/src/i18n/zh/common.json:2-14). envSchema currently validates JWT secrets separately and validate wraps Joi error without exposing field name; ensure JWT_REFRESH_SECRET is identifiable in equal-secret validation error (apps/api/src/config/env.validation.ts:5-15,39-45). KodaDomainWriter currently trusts user-provided actorRole/role, while its repository only finds a project; fetch User.role and ProjectMember.role by project/user, ignore user payload roles, leave agent handling and WriteTicketEventInput unchanged (apps/api/src/koda-domain-writer/koda-domain-writer.service.ts:60-118; apps/api/src/koda-domain-writer/prisma-koda-domain-writer.repository.ts:1-12). Existing tests to adapt include tickets.controller.spec.ts, rag.controller.spec.ts, retrieval.controller.spec.ts, projects.controller.spec.ts, projects.service.spec.ts, comments.service.spec.ts, agents.service.spec.ts and koda-domain-writer.service.spec.ts; add specified guard, agent repository and HTTP integration specs. Risks: global CASL guard ordering may return a permission 403 before a handler; the spec's US-002 positive route-matrix requirement (every member DEVELOPER request is neither 403 nor 404) is in tension with the existing project-agent PATCH admin/self restriction and certain CASL write permissions (apps/api/src/projects/projects.controller.ts:190-208). Preserve the AC while avoiding inadvertent global permission changes; design fixtures and report any irreducible policy conflict. Integration should use real ProjectMember rows, not claims. US-001 precedes US-002 (integration exercises its new guard), and US-001/US-003 precede US-005 (cleanup consumes their changes). No database migration or new agent membership model.
outOfScope: Project-role-based permissions: write permissions stay on the principal's global role and `ProjectMember.role` gates visibility only (Track 3 ruling 2026-09-27), with one exception ruled 2026-09-27: KB write routes refuse a project VIEWER via `@ProjectRoles`. Tickets, comments and labels do not use `@ProjectRoles`.
Agent project membership: agent principals remain cross-project and bypass the membership gate (revisited in fleet S1).
Hiding project existence from authenticated non-members: an unknown slug returns 404 while a non-member gets 403, matching the modules already gated.
The webhook, ticket-workflow, VCS, RAG and web/CLI findings of Track 3 slices 2-6.
US-003 only: the agent `update()` path, which already whitelists its fields.
